create_boxstack_simulation: create a BoxStackPyBulletSim instance with a pybullet client to initialize a 4-cube stacking simulation
reset_simulation_state: reset the BoxStackPyBulletSim simulation to initial states with randomized cube positions and orientations
get_observation_data: get the observation list containing position and quaternion orientation for each cube in the simulation
apply_action_to_sim: apply an action to the simulation by calling ApplyAction which increments the action counter
check_termination_condition: check if the simulation has terminated by calling Termination which returns true after 200 actions
